hint_ladder: Remind someone of a fact you are fairly, but not completely, sure of.
Use the phrase at the front of the sentence, before the comma.
Start with the words: ___, the meeting was moved to Thursday.
teaching_content.reveal_form: If I'm not mistaken, the meeting was moved to Thursday.
canonical_forms: If I'm not mistaken, the meeting was moved to Thursday.
alternative_realizations: If I'm not mistaken, you were at the same school as my cousin.
